summary.text: Jerry Stringham is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 3 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business executive, he previously served in the House from Grafton 5 from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Jerry Stringham earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1981 and an M.B.A. from Harvard University.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as founding several companies and serving as president of Medical Technology Partners.
Ballotpedia also lists service as president of the Lincoln-Woodstock Rotary Executive Committee, a PTA president and a trustee of Jean's Playhouse.
Stringham first served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 5 from 2018 to 2020, a seat later held by Bonnie Ham (R).
He returned to the House representing Grafton 3 on December 7, 2022, succeeding Denny Ruprecht (D).
He was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee in 2019-2020 and to the House Finance Committee and its Finance - Division III Committee in 2023-2024.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia biographical submission, Stringham gave his political philosophy as improving efficiency and access to affordable health care, protecting natural resources and sound fiscal management.
